events.label: 2077 corporate-state; Liber8 terrorists sentenced
events.description: In 2077, corporations rule and everyone else lives under their control - City Protective Services officer Kiera Cameron guards a system she believes in.

events.label: Liber8 time-travel escape; Kiera pulled along
events.description: Sentenced terrorists, Liber8, escape their execution by jumping to 2012 - and Kiera is dragged along with them, stranded sixty-five years early.

events.label: Arrive Vancouver 2012; Kiera joins VPD via CSC
events.description: Kiera lands in Vancouver and, with the police force of this era unable to process the future, joins the VPD using a cover story from the last service standing.

events.label: Meet young Alec Sadler — future corporate architect
events.description: Kiera meets teenage Alec Sadler - a brilliant loner in 2012 who will grow up to build the very corporate world she served, and whose tech she already wears.

events.label: Liber8 attacks reshape tech/politics toward their future
events.description: Liber8's attacks on banks and corporations push this era's politics and technology along the road to the future they fled - the terrorists are shaping the timeline they came from.

events.label: Kellog plays markets for personal empire
events.description: Alec's uncle Kellog plays the stock market with future knowledge and plays both sides of the conflict, quietly building his own empire.

events.label: Multiple time jumps create duplicate Alecs/Kieras
events.description: As more travellers jump through time, duplicates begin to pile up: two Alecs, two Kieras, each version with its own claim on the future.

events.label: Alec saves Emily; aborts one future path
events.description: Alec chooses to save Emily, and in doing so kills off one version of his own future - a path closed by a single decision.

events.label: Finale: stop darker path / future soldiers portal
events.description: In the endgame, Liber8's darkest plan opens a doorway for soldiers from a worse 2077 - and Kiera faces the future she left coming back through.

events.label: Alec sabotages keys; invasion collapses
events.description: Alec sabotages the key that opens the doorway, and the invasion collapses before it can begin.

events.label: Kiera reaches better 2077
events.description: Kiera finally reaches 2077 again - a kinder version of it, the one her actions in 2012 helped make possible.

events.label: Variant Kiera already exists as Sam's mother
events.description: There is already another Kiera here: a variant who lived these years first, and is the mother of young Sam.

events.label: Bittersweet acceptance of changed future she cannot fully rejoin
events.description: Kiera accepts the bittersweet ending - the future she returns to is better than the one she lost, but it is no longer quite hers.

events.label: 2077 corporate future cops
events.description: The corporate future of 2077, where police serve companies and freedom is a managed resource.

events.label: Kiera jumps to 2012 with Liber8
events.description: Kiera is thrown back to 2012 alongside the terrorists she was guarding.

events.label: Vancouver police embed
events.description: Embedding with the Vancouver police of 2012, badge and lies in hand.

events.label: Young Alec Sadler nexus
events.description: Young Alec - the boy genius whose inventions and future empire hang over every choice.

events.label: Stop/alter Liber8 attacks
events.description: Fighting, out-manoeuvring and occasionally agreeing with the revolutionaries from her own time.

events.label: Future messages rewrite
events.description: Messages from the future keep rewriting what Kiera knows about how her story ends.

events.label: CMR / time travel tech politics
events.description: The politics of the future's technology in a past that hasn't learned to fear it yet.

events.label: Series future renegotiation
events.description: The series closes with the future renegotiated - not saved, not damned, changed.

ruleEffects.effect: Finale forks a better 2077 Kiera cannot fully reclaim
Young Alec still seeds the tech future travelers depend on

outcome.summary: Kiera reaches a better 2077 already inhabited by a variant self; Liber8/corporate war rewritten; bittersweet closure.
